metadata.name: mastra
metadata.description: Mastra is the modern TypeScript framework for AI-powered applications and agents.

summary.zh: Mastra是基于TypeScript的现代化AI代理开发框架，集成40+模型路由、图工作流编排、人机协作、上下文记忆及MCP服务器等核心能力。它支持React、Next.js、Node.js前后端无缝集成，内置评估与可观测性工具，帮助开发者从原型快速构建生产级AI智能体应用。
summary.en: Mastra is a modern TypeScript framework for building AI-powered applications and agents. It offers unified model routing across 40+ LLM providers, a graph-based workflow engine, autonomous agents with tool use, human-in-the-loop support, context management with memory and RAG, and MCP server capabilities. It integrates with React, Next.js, and Node.js, providing built-in evaluation and observability for production-grade AI development.

metadata.name: ai-agents-from-zero
metadata.description: 🚀 2026 最系统的 AI Agent 速成指南｜智能体实战教程 · 完整学习路径  + 实战项目 + 面试题库 · 对标大模型应用开发工程师岗位 · 覆盖LangChain / LangGraph / Coze / Dify / MCP / skills / LLM / RAG / 提示词 · 企业级部署与微调 · 从0到企业级落地 + 从学习到上线项目 + 面试准备一体化

summary.zh: 系统性AI智能体实战教程，覆盖LangChain、LangGraph、Coze、Dify、MCP、RAG等主流技术栈，提供完整学习路径、可运行源码、企业级实战项目（电商问数、深度研搜）及面试题库，对标大模型应用开发工程师岗位，从零基础到企业级落地一体化。
summary.en: A systematic AI Agent tutorial covering LangChain, LangGraph, Coze, Dify, MCP, and RAG. Features runnable source code, enterprise-grade projects (NL2SQL, multi-agent deep search), interview question bank, and a complete learning path from zero to deployment, targeting AI application engineer roles in 2026.

metadata.name: Kun
metadata.description: Local-first AI agent workspace for coding, writing, design, research, and automation — one runtime for desktop GUI and TUI.

summary.zh: Kun 是本地优先的 AI Agent 工作台，将桌面 GUI 与终端 TUI 共享同一运行时，覆盖编程、写作、设计、研究与自动化五大场景。支持多模型接入、Agent Graph 多智能体编排、MCP 协议与定时任务，跨 macOS、Windows、Linux 平台，会话数据默认本地存储。
summary.en: Kun is a local-first AI Agent workspace that unifies a desktop GUI and terminal TUI on a single shared runtime, delivering end-to-end task traceability from clarification through execution to delivery. It spans five integrated workflows—coding, writing, design, research, and automation—and provides multi-model provider compatibility, Agent Graph multi-agent orchestration, MCP protocol integration, and Schedule/Loop/Hook automation primitives. Available across macOS, Windows, and Linux with sessions, preferences, and runtime data stored locally by default for privacy and offline access.

summary.zh: Vibe-Trading 是一款AI驱动的个人交易智能体框架，一行命令即可为智能体赋能完整交易能力。集成 FastAPI 后端、React 19 前端与 Electron 桌面端，支持 eToro 等多平台券商接口，提供影子账户模拟交易、原子化再平衡回测与 MCP API 服务，面向 AI 代理自动化交易场景。
summary.en: Vibe-Trading is an AI-powered personal trading agent framework that empowers agents with comprehensive trading capabilities via a single command. It integrates a FastAPI backend, React 19 frontend, and Electron desktop shell, supporting multi-broker integration (eToro), shadow paper-trading accounts, atomic rebalancing backtesting, and MCP API server, designed for AI-agent-driven automated trading workflows.

metadata.name: agent-study
metadata.description: 36章AI Agent全栈课程：从ReAct循环到Claude Code逆向、MCP/A2A协议、RAG、DSPy、生产可观测性——全部为可运行Python文件，面试导向。

summary.zh: 36章AI Agent全栈课程，覆盖从ReAct循环、LangChain/LangGraph框架到Claude Code逆向、MCP/A2A协议、RAG与DSPy等核心主题，每章均为可独立运行的Python文件，分7层递进，含22000+行代码与60+示例，配套在线文档，专为求职者面试打造。
summary.en: A comprehensive 36-chapter AI Agent full-stack course covering ReAct loops, LangChain/LangGraph frameworks, Claude Code reverse engineering, MCP/A2A protocols, RAG deep-dive, and DSPy. Each chapter is a runnable Python file organized across 7 progressive layers, featuring 22,000+ lines of code, 60+ examples, online documentation, and interview-oriented content for job seekers.
